r13_contract.comparisonModel: IF iceClass = 'IA Super', THEN forefoot_shell_strengthening_status = bow_region_equivalent for the specified five-main-frame-spacing extent. IF iceClass IN {'IA Super','IA'} AND open_water_service_speed_kn >= 18, THEN upper_bow_ice_belt_strengthening_status = midbody_equivalent for the area from the ice-belt upper limit to 2 m above it and at least 0.2*L aft of the forward perpendicular. sidescuttle_in_ice_belt = false. IF weather_deck_below_ice_belt_upper_limit = true, THEN bulwark_strength_status and freeing_port_strength_status shall meet the ice-belt shell requirement. The lower-speed model-test sentence is advisory and is not encoded as a mandatory constraint.
r13_contract.verificationPolicyBasis: The category policy is based on the source requirement and intrinsic verification method. It is independent of whether any particular LLM model previously succeeded or failed to generate a SHACL shape.

test_cases.rationale: IA Super: forefoot strengthening is bow-equivalent and sidescuttles are excluded.
IA at the 18 kn trigger has upper-bow belt strengthening equivalent to the midbody requirement.
IB at high open-water speed does not trigger the IA/IA Super upper-bow extension.
IA below 18 kn does not trigger the mandatory upper-bow extension.
Weather deck below the ice-belt upper limit has compliant bulwark and freeing-port strength.
A sidescuttle is situated in the ice belt.
IA Super forefoot strengthening is not provided.
IA at or above 18 kn lacks the required upper-bow belt strengthening.
Weather deck is below the upper ice-belt limit but bulwark strength is non-compliant.
Weather deck is below the upper ice-belt limit but freeing-port strength is non-compliant.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
